{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''power-consuming organism''' was created by an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was microscopic and capable of self-replication, and was genetically programmed to hunt down and consume power sources. Created to end a civil war, the organism destroyed the enemy's weapons of mass destruction, which in turn caused their opponent to release a virus that killed the majority of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] population and mutate the rest.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a colony was established on the planet. The organism drained the colonist's power sources, and an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] team was sent to investigate the cause.
